what_works: Pure black-on-white shell with a fullscreen menu overlay and project-detail pages that read like an architecture monograph. Translates beautifully for a high-touch service brand that wants to feel like 'the firm,' not 'the contractor.'
what_does_not_translate: The fullscreen 3D intro animation and complex page-transition state machine will eat the build budget — keep the editorial restraint, skip the WebGL.
type_observations: Single high-end serif or near-grotesk display at huge sizes against generous whitespace; body type is a small disciplined sans.
